steps.title: I arrive at the office.
steps.body: I walk in with my helper. It might be busy.

steps.title: I check in at the front desk.
steps.body: I say my name. They may ask for my card.

notice.text: a little nervous. That is okay.

steps.title: I wait in the waiting room.
steps.body: I sit and wait for my name. I can bring something I like.

steps.title: I look at a chart.
steps.body: I cover one eye. I say the letters or pictures I see. Nothing is graded.

steps.title: I look into a machine.
steps.body: I put my chin on a rest. I look at a light. Some machines blow a little puff of air.

steps.title: I might get eye drops.
steps.body: The drops may sting a little. My eyes may be blurry for a while. That goes away.

notice.text: I can ask before they start.

steps.title: I'm done. I can go home.
steps.body: We say goodbye. I did it!
